title: 1.3a Zero-width clusters must not fall back to width 1
description:
## Background

Found in orchestrator review of run R1 (commit dba5432). ADR 0001 cluster rule 1 says that when every code point in a cluster is zero-width, the cluster has width 1. That rule was meant for degenerate combining sequences (for example a lone U+0301, which terminals draw on a dotted circle or as a spacing glyph). As written, it also gives width 1 to clusters that are invisible or structural: U+200B ZERO WIDTH SPACE, U+FEFF, U+00AD, a lone U+200D, a lone U+FE0F, and controls such as "\n" (each of these is its own cluster under UAX #29, GCB=Control or Extend). Verified: `(cluster-width "​" {})` gives 1, and so do "\n", U+FEFF, U+00AD, lone ZWJ and lone VS16. Once 1.6 routes visible-width through clusters, "Hello​World" would measure 11 and "a\nb" 3, contradicting ADR 0001 code-point rules 2 and 3.

## Fix

Amend ADR 0001 (as an explicit amendment section, dated) and `limner.unicode.width/cluster-width`: a cluster whose code points are all zero-width has width 0 when its first code point is Cc, Cf, Zl, Zp, or Default_Ignorable_Code_Point (or more generally: when it contains no combining mark, i.e. no Mn/Me). The width-1 fallback applies only to clusters that start with a combining mark (Mn/Me). Check the precedent in Python wcwidth's wcswidth for isolated marks and for ZWSP, and cite it.

## Acceptance

Red tests first. Exact tests: ZWSP, "\n", "\t", U+FEFF, U+00AD, lone U+200D and lone U+FE0F give 0; lone U+0301 gives 1 (or whatever the amended ADR decides, with justification); all existing width tests still pass. Mutation-prove the new rule. The exhaustive width oracle test is updated to encode the amendment. bb check passes on both runtimes.
close_reason: Amended ADR 0001 and cluster-width so only non-default-ignorable leading Mn/Me marks receive the width-1 fallback; verified by exact, exhaustive/sample oracle, mutation, and both-runtime gates.

title: Empty documentation quality-gate baselines after 0.2 and 0.3
description: PLAN 0.4 records 24 unresolved API references in test/limner/baselines/doc_references.edn and 3 failing runnable README blocks in test/limner/baselines/readme_examples.edn. PLAN 0.2 must correct or remove the README entries and PLAN 0.3 must archive or correct the fictional tutorial entries. Baseline entries may only be removed.

title: 1.8 Establish text performance baselines and budgets
description:
## Background

REVIEW finding C4 and PLAN.md item 1.8 show large JVM/babashka performance differences with no representative corpus or regression budget.

## Fix

Benchmark ASCII, marked Latin, CJK, emoji sequences, and styled text on both runtimes; record measured baselines and derive budgets from those results.

## Acceptance

A single documented command runs the corpus on JVM and babashka; results record runtime versions and measured throughput; enforced budgets are justified by data and fail under a deliberate performance regression.
close_reason: Closed

title: 1.7 Run Unicode conformance and width oracles
description:
## Background

REVIEW findings C1-C3 and PLAN.md item 1.7 require full-data validation and explained comparisons rather than spot fixes.

## Fix

Verify all fully-qualified emoji sequences and every EastAsianWidth code point, then compare against glibc wcwidth and Python wcwidth with every difference classified by version or policy.

## Acceptance

Every fully-qualified emoji-test sequence measures 2; every EAW code point matches ADR 0001 on JVM and babashka; oracle reports are reproducible and contain no unexplained difference.
close_reason: Closed

title: 1.6 Build the styled text and column operations layer
description:
## Background

REVIEW findings B1, B3, B4, and G1 and PLAN.md item 1.6 identify reset-clobbered nesting and code-unit-based measurement throughout the library.

## Fix

Add limner.text spans, ANSI parsing, column width, safe slicing, padding, truncation, wrapping, and minimal-SGR rendering; implement core/color and core/visible-width on that foundation.

## Acceptance

Nested outer style survives inner style; column operations never split a grapheme, wide cell, or surrogate; truncation always fits; rendering and reparsing preserve spans; exact and property tests pass on both runtimes.
close_reason: Closed

title: 1.5 Add one ECMA-48 ANSI tokenizer
description:
## Background

REVIEW findings B2 and B4 and PLAN.md item 1.5 identify seven SGR-only regexes that count or retain other control sequences incorrectly.

## Fix

Add limner.ansi with one ECMA-48 tokenizer for CSI, OSC with BEL or ST, DCS, APC, PM, SOS, two-byte ESC sequences, and C1 controls; migrate every regex copy to it.

## Acceptance

CSI erase and OSC 8 hyperlinks are zero-width; all seven legacy regex copies are gone; tokenize then reserialize is property-tested to equal the original input on JVM and babashka.
close_reason: Vendored ECMA-48 and xterm references; implemented one total lossless tokenizer with SGR/OSC8 helpers; migrated all seven SGR-only regex sites; documented and verified behavior, mutations, and performance on both runtimes.

title: 1.4 Implement portable UAX 29 grapheme segmentation
description:
## Background

REVIEW findings C3 and G5 and PLAN.md item 1.4 show that BreakIterator is version-dependent and fails 17 official Unicode 17.0.0 cases.

## Fix

Write ADR 0002 and limner.unicode.grapheme in portable Clojure using generated properties, including GB9c InCB; drive it with official conformance data and cross-check it with optional ICU4J tests.

## Acceptance

All 766 GraphemeBreakTest-17.0.0 cases pass on JVM and babashka; a deliberate segmentation mutation makes the conformance test fail and is then restored; the optional JVM oracle comparison is documented and green.
close_reason: Implemented portable Unicode 17 extended grapheme segmentation with allocation-free ranges, exact conformance/property tests, optional ICU4J oracle, ADR 0002, and reproducible performance comparison.

title: 1.3 Record terminal width semantics in ADR 0001
description:
## Background

REVIEW findings B3, C1, C2, and C4 and PLAN.md item 1.3 require an explicit policy for Unicode properties, emoji, controls, tabs, and ambiguous width.

## Fix

Write ADR 0001 implementing accepted decision D3: UCD 17.0.0, W/F width 2, A width 1 by default with explicit width-2 option, zero-width ignorables and marks, documented control and tab policy, and cluster adjustments for emoji and variation selectors.

## Acceptance

The ADR resolves every policy bullet in PLAN.md 1.3; limner.unicode/version exposes 17.0.0; examples cover W, F, A, ignorables, VS15, VS16, regional indicators, and tab/control handling.
close_reason: Recorded UCD 17 terminal width policy in ADR 0001, vendored the reviewed Unicode reports, implemented pure scalar and cluster widths, and verified exhaustive/sample raw-data oracles plus mutations on both runtimes

title: 1.2 Generate compact Unicode tables deterministically
description:
## Background

REVIEW findings C1 and C4 and PLAN.md item 1.2 require replacing handwritten ranges with generated, reviewable data.

## Fix

Add a babashka generator that emits compact, binary-searched range vectors in src/limner/unicode/tables.clj with an autogenerated Unicode-version banner.

## Acceptance

Generation from the vendored files is byte-for-byte deterministic; a drift test detects any generated-table edit; the generated namespace states Unicode 17.0.0 and loads on JVM and babashka.
close_reason: Added deterministic UCD table generation, compact binary-search lookups, independent raw-data and drift tests, mutation proof, performance measurements, and API documentation

title: 1.1 Vendor and verify Unicode 17.0.0 data
description:
## Background

REVIEW findings C1-C3 and PLAN.md item 1.1 show that width and segmentation have no pinned canonical data.

## Fix

Vendor the listed UCD 17.0.0 width, emoji, grapheme-break, derived-core, and general-category files under reference/unicode/17.0.0; add SHA256SUMS and a babashka fetch-and-verify script.

## Acceptance

Every file named by PLAN.md 1.1 is present at the required path; SHA-256 verification passes from a clean checkout; downloads are pinned to Unicode 17.0.0 and tests do not depend on network access.
close_reason: Vendored Unicode 17.0.0 and Emoji 17.0 data with checksums, licence, guarded refresh tooling, and cross-runtime integrity coverage

title: 0.5 Remove time and terminal effects from tests
description:
## Background

REVIEW findings G2 and G3 and PLAN.md item 0.5 identify sleeps, wall-clock assertions, real terminal output, and stty calls in tests.

## Fix

Inject clocks, writers, and terminal size; replace sleep and performance timing assertions with deterministic control; capture output without touching the real terminal.

## Acceptance

Tests contain no Thread/sleep or wall-clock performance assertion; terminal-facing tests use injected dependencies and captured output; both runtime suites pass deterministically.
close_reason: Closed

title: 0.3 Archive fictional docs and stale artifacts
description:
## Background

REVIEW findings A4-A6 and H and PLAN.md item 0.3 identify a tutorial for nonexistent APIs, stale plans and benchmark output, marketing source prose, and duplicate ignores.

## Fix

Move plans and docs/tutorial.md under docs/archive/2025 with historical warnings, remove benchmark_results.txt and the bulletproof header, and deduplicate .gitignore.

## Acceptance

Archived documents carry the required historical banner; active docs do not present nonexistent APIs; benchmark_results.txt and the marketing header are absent; .gitignore has no duplicate entries.
close_reason: Closed

title: 0.2 Make README claims and examples honest
description:

REVIEW findings A1-A3 and A5 and PLAN.md item 0.2 identify unsupported claims, placeholder metadata, marketing prose, and broken examples.

## Fix

## Acceptance

Every README function reference resolves; every example executes under the quality gate; no production-ready, unsupported metric, or unsupported compatibility claim remains; issue #2 is named as a known limitation.
close_reason: Closed

title: Phase 1: ground truth and text foundation
description:
## Background

REVIEW findings B1-B4, C1-C4, and G5 motivate PLAN.md Phase 1.

## Fix

Build a portable, Unicode-17.0.0-backed ANSI, grapheme, width, and styled-text foundation for both runtimes.

## Acceptance

All Phase 1 child issues are closed; Unicode and ANSI conformance tests pass on JVM and babashka; the issue #2 follow-up is drafted with evidence.
close_reason: all steps complete

title: Phase 3 panel: verify the shared text foundation
description:
## Background

REVIEW finding B3 establishes the cross-component column bug; PLAN.md Phase 3 component panel requires panel to be checked against the new text layer.

## Fix

Move all panel measurement, truncation, padding, and styling through limner.text; split oversized code if needed and rewrite the namespace docstring as an explanation of its invariants.

## Acceptance

Panel content, titles, and styles render exactly for ASCII, CJK, emoji, and ANSI input; every rendered line has the configured display width; goldens and properties pass on both runtimes.

title: Phase 3 statusbar: preserve styles within columns
description:
## Background

REVIEW findings F9, B2, and B3 and PLAN.md Phase 3 component statusbar show caller styles being discarded, duplicated background logic, and CJK overflow.

## Fix

Render through limner.text spans, preserve caller styles, remove duplicated ANSI handling, measure columns, split oversized code, and rewrite the namespace docstring.

## Acceptance

Caller foreground and attributes survive composition; status bars fit their configured columns for CJK, emoji, and ANSI input; exact style goldens and every-line-width properties pass on both runtimes.

title: Phase 3 progress: numeric completion and valid spinners
description:
## Background

REVIEW finding F4 and D3 and PLAN.md Phase 3 component progress show type-sensitive completion, invalid spinner crashes, and duplicate styles.

## Fix

Use numeric comparison for completion, validate spinner styles fail-loud, remove or differentiate duplicate style data, migrate text operations, and rewrite the namespace docstring.

## Acceptance

Integer and floating values complete consistently; unknown styles throw actionable ex-info before ticking; style names map to distinct documented behavior; exact goldens and width properties pass on both runtimes.

title: Phase 3 input: grapheme cursor and exact rendering
description:
## Background

REVIEW findings F1, B1, and B3 and PLAN.md Phase 3 component input show nil history state, placeholder escape corruption, wrong trailing-newline cursors, and code-unit indexing.

## Fix

Use grapheme-indexed cursor movement and limner.text styles, correct placeholder and multiline rendering, make history-prev total, remove color reset, split code, and rewrite the docstring.

## Acceptance

Cursor operations never split graphemes; placeholder and trailing-newline cases match exact output; empty history returns unchanged state; nested style remains intact; line-width properties pass on both runtimes.

title: Phase 3 list: safe widths, filtering, and scrolling
description:
## Background

REVIEW findings F2 and B3 and PLAN.md Phase 3 component list show narrow-width crashes, CJK overflow, inverted filtering state, and off-screen selection.

## Fix

Move list rendering onto limner.text; validate minimum widths; repair set-filter and selection scrolling; split oversized code and rewrite the namespace docstring.

## Acceptance

Narrow invalid widths throw ex-info rather than substring errors; CJK and styled items fit; filter and navigation state match exact tests; goldens and every-line-width properties pass on both runtimes.

title: Phase 3 table: promote a column-correct namespace
description:
## Background

REVIEW findings F8 and B3 and PLAN.md Phase 3 component table show that the legacy top-level table misaligns CJK and accepts ragged rows.

## Fix

Add limner.table on limner.text with explicit alignment options and validation; deprecate the duplicated top-level implementation according to decision D4.

## Acceptance

Tables align ASCII, CJK, emoji, and styled cells by display columns; ragged rows throw actionable ex-info; alignment options have exact goldens and every rendered line satisfies its width property on both runtimes.

title: Phase 3 layout: exact allocation and validation
description:
## Background

REVIEW findings F6, B3, D1, and D2 and PLAN.md Phase 3 component layout show dropped flex remainders, code-unit clipping, and inconsistent validation.

## Fix

Move layout text operations onto limner.text, distribute flex remainder by largest remainder, unify fail-loud validation, and turn the README layout example into a test.

## Acceptance

Allocated sizes plus spacing equal available space; clipping never exceeds requested columns; invalid constraints throw documented ex-info; exact goldens, README example, and width properties pass on both runtimes.

title: Phase 3 borders: column-correct structured boxes
description:
## Background

REVIEW findings F7 and B3 and PLAN.md Phase 3 component borders show incorrect title widths, glyph-sniffed coloring, and undefined tab behavior.

## Fix

Move borders onto limner.text; measure and truncate titles by columns; color from box structure; decide the tab policy; split oversized code and replace the namespace docstring.

## Acceptance

CJK and styled titles fit exactly; rounded and thick borders color every border segment; tabs follow the documented policy; exact goldens and the every-line-width property pass on both runtimes.

title: 2.6 Eliminate reflection warnings
description:
## Background

REVIEW finding G5 and PLAN.md item 2.6 record a baseline of 18 warnings when all namespaces load with reflection warnings enabled.

## Fix

Remove the causes of every reflection warning without JVM-only behavior or warning suppression.

## Acceptance

Loading every source namespace with *warn-on-reflection* emits exactly zero warnings on the JVM; the babashka suite remains green; the quality gate baseline is reduced from 18 to 0.
close_reason: Reflection remains at zero; corrected the practical guidance to match the enforced empty baseline.

title: 2.5 Remove unsafe event concurrency
description:
## Background

REVIEW findings E1 and E2 and PLAN.md item 2.5 identify blocking operations in go blocks, uncancelled timed-out handlers, and reset-based lost state updates.

## Fix

Under accepted decision D4, either rebuild events with nonblocking go behavior, atomic updates, cancellation, and documented lifecycle, or explicitly retain it as experimental with clear limitations.

## Acceptance

No blocking core.async operation executes inside go; concurrent updates are not lost; timeout and cancellation behavior has deterministic tests; any remaining limitations appear in namespace and README documentation.

title: 2.4 Add POSIX terminal input and capability handling
description:
## Background

REVIEW findings E4 and E5 and PLAN.md item 2.4 show missing raw input, incomplete keys, repeated stty calls, arbitrary size fallbacks, and incomplete capability policy.

## Fix

Implement accepted decision D7 as limner.tty: finally-safe POSIX raw mode, timeout-aware ESC reader, xterm keys and modifiers including Shift-Tab, bracketed paste, SGR mouse, injectable size, and explicit color capability inputs.

## Acceptance

Raw mode always restores after success or failure; key, paste, and mouse fixtures parse exactly; NO_COLOR, FORCE_COLOR, TTY, Windows policy, and babashka capability behavior are documented and tested without touching the real terminal.

title: 2.3 Serialize and inject render-loop effects
description:
## Background

REVIEW findings E3, G2, and G3 and PLAN.md item 2.3 identify terminal writes inside retryable swap functions, competing writers, and untestable time and size effects.

## Fix

Route rendering through one writer thread; make force-render a request; inject writer, clock, and terminal-size source; define and test stop semantics.

## Acceptance

No I/O occurs inside swap functions; all terminal bytes come from one writer; deterministic tests cover force, stop, errors, and size changes without real terminal access or sleeps on both runtimes.

title: 2.2 Make the render buffer grapheme- and style-aware
description:
## Background

REVIEW findings B3 and B4 and PLAN.md item 2.2 show that buffers split surrogate pairs and accumulate unequal ANSI strings for visually identical cells.

## Fix

Store one grapheme and style per cell, represent wide-cell continuations, emit row-run diffs through a style state machine, and test byte streams with a minimal virtual terminal.

## Acceptance

Emoji and wide graphemes occupy correct cells without surrogate halves; equivalent visual styles compare equal; exact virtual-terminal goldens verify initial and differential rendering on JVM and babashka.
close_reason: Closed

title: 2.1 Adopt fail-loud error policy in the next-numbered ADR
description:
## Background

REVIEW findings D1-D3 and PLAN.md item 2.1 identify 41 catch-and-fabricate paths, stderr output, AssertionError leakage, and inconsistent defaults.

## Fix

Write ADR 0003; replace fabricated values and preconditions with explicit ex-info carrying :limner/error data; retain only one documented opt-in render-loop boundary.

## Acceptance

No library catch Exception remains outside the named boundary; invalid public inputs throw ex-info with actionable data; no library error path prints to stderr; exact tests cover every migrated error class on both runtimes.
close_reason: Completed R4 review: added the omitted fail-loud spinner validation and exact event error-class coverage.

title: 0.7 Prepare and perform owner-approved outreach
description:
## Background

REVIEW findings C2 and C3 and the Replies owed section support PLAN.md item 0.7 and decision D8; CLAUDE.md Rule 14 requires approval of exact public text.

## Fix

Update the draft reply for limner issue #2 and the draft clj-wcwidth report with current evidence, then give the exact text to the owner. The owner performs all posting.

## Acceptance

Evidence and commands are reproducible; the owner approves the exact final text; no agent posts, edits, or closes anything on GitHub; the owner confirms any desired posts are complete.

title: 0.6 Start changelog and create legacy baseline tag
description:
## Background

REVIEW finding H and PLAN.md item 0.6 apply accepted decision D5: honest 0.x versioning needs a changelog and stable legacy baseline.

## Fix

Add CHANGELOG.md for the legacy baseline and prepare the v0.1.0 tag at the agreed current commit. The owner creates and pushes the tag.

## Acceptance

CHANGELOG.md truthfully describes the legacy baseline and pre-release status; the exact target and tag command are handed to the owner; only the owner creates or pushes v0.1.0.
close_reason: CHANGELOG and documentation guidance complete; pending tag handoff recorded in the issue comment

title: Phase 3: components on the text foundation
description:
## Background

REVIEW findings F1-F9 and B3 identify component defects collected in PLAN.md Phase 3.

## Fix

Move every core and experimental component onto limner.text with red-first probes, exact golden tests, width properties, small namespaces, and explanatory docstrings.

## Acceptance

All Phase 3 component issues are closed; every REVIEW F probe has the specified answer; component goldens and properties pass on JVM and babashka.

title: Phase 2: fail-loud core and sound render path
description:
## Background

REVIEW findings D1-D3, E1-E5, B4, B3, and G5 define the failures addressed by PLAN.md Phase 2.

## Fix

## Acceptance

All Phase 2 child issues are closed; catch-and-fabricate remains only at the documented opt-in boundary; render goldens and both runtime suites pass.

title: Phase 4 shadows: visually analysed redesign of drop shadows (Opus)
description:
## Background

Owner feedback (2026-09-15): the drop shadows (`limner.borders/add-shadow`, `add-heavy-shadow`) "were just awful". REVIEW B3 and F7 cover the borders namespace generally. The archived 2025 plan (docs/archive/2025/code_review.md, item 11) already recorded "Shadow effects have incorrect light source physics". Known code-level issues: the bottom shadow width is taken from the first line's visible width only; the right shadow starts on the top border line's neighbour inconsistently with the bottom offset; shade glyphs (░ ▓) are drawn as foreground characters instead of darkening the background; there is no handling of wide characters or styled lines.

## Fix

Owner-directed exception to the Codex execution policy: this task is done by a **Claude Opus subagent** with visual analysis, after everything else has landed.

1. Render a matrix of shadowed boxes (all border styles, small/large, titled, coloured, CJK content, light and dark terminal backgrounds) through a real terminal emulator or an ANSI-to-image renderer, and capture PNGs.
2. Analyse the images with the vision skill: what reads as a convincing drop shadow on a character grid (offset direction and size, half-block vs shade glyphs vs background-colour darkening, corner treatment, degradation on 16-colour and no-colour terminals).
3. Decide the design in an ADR with before/after images committed under docs/adr/assets or reviews/.
4. Red-green: pin the geometry with exact-output golden tests and a property test (shadow is exactly offset and sized from the box on every line), on both runtimes, built on limner.text.

## Acceptance

Before/after images show a clearly correct drop shadow across the matrix; the owner has looked at the after images; golden and property tests pass on JVM and babashka; the capability fallback (no colour / no Unicode) is defined and tested.

title: Phase 4: publish verified documentation and prepare release
description:
## Background

REVIEW findings A1-A6 and H and PLAN.md Phase 4 require user documentation and release material to be rebuilt from verified behavior after Phase 3.

## Fix

Generate API docs from docstrings; write a short tutorial whose code blocks execute in tests; update CHANGELOG.md with reporter credit; prepare v0.2.0 or later and possible Clojars publication; draft the owner-controlled issue #2 closing comment.

## Acceptance

Generated API docs match public vars; every tutorial block executes on JVM and babashka; CHANGELOG.md credits reporters; release artifacts and draft closing text cite green gates; only the owner tags, publishes, or posts.

title: Phase 3 streaming: use grapheme positions
description:
## Background

REVIEW finding B3 and PLAN.md Phase 3 component streaming show code-unit positions that can emit lone surrogate halves.

## Fix

Represent streaming progress and slicing in grapheme clusters through limner.text; keep the namespace experimental until its behavior is fully documented and tested.

## Acceptance

Streaming a😀b at every position never emits a lone surrogate or partial grapheme; styled input remains valid; exact sequence tests and width properties pass on both runtimes.

title: Phase 3 markdown: define and verify an experimental subset
description:
## Background

REVIEW findings F3, B1, and A4 and PLAN.md Phase 3 component markdown show emphasis inside identifiers, a renderer arity failure, unsupported modeled nesting, ignored syntax integration, and unsafe global mutation.

## Fix

Either implement a documented CommonMark subset against matching official examples with correct arities and dynamic renderer binding, or retain markdown as experimental with each known limitation explicit; use limner.text styles.

## Acceptance

The chosen subset and exclusions are documented; list rendering has no arity failure; custom renderers are dynamically scoped; matching CommonMark examples and exact style goldens pass on JVM and babashka.

title: Phase 3 syntax: bounded tokenizer with honest configuration
description:
## Background

REVIEW findings F5, B2, and B3 and PLAN.md Phase 3 component syntax show keyword matches inside identifiers, quadratic scanning, duplicated ANSI handling, and unused configuration.

## Fix

Keep syntax experimental while replacing scanning with a linear-time boundary-aware tokenizer; either implement or remove unused language and theme keys; migrate rendering to limner.text and rewrite the docstring.

## Acceptance

Identifiers such as my-def are not partially highlighted; benchmark growth is linear within a documented tolerance; every exposed configuration key affects output or is removed with docs; exact tests pass on both runtimes.

title: Phase 4: documentation and release
description:
## Background

REVIEW findings A1-A6 and H require the release/documentation work in PLAN.md Phase 4 after component correctness is established.

## Fix

Publish verified API documentation and tutorial material, record reporter credit, prepare the next release, and draft the owner-controlled closing reply.

## Acceptance

The Phase 4 child issue is closed; every tutorial block executes in tests; release notes credit reporters; any tag, publication, or GitHub post is performed only by the owner.
